claims.review_boundary: Rolling-block evidence only; no global-optimality claim.
claims.statement: Across six regions, 90 successful rolling binary-MILP solves (14 blocks of 168 hours and one block of 55 hours per region) cover supplied hours 0--2406 exactly once; this is not a global 2407-hour MILP result.

claims.review_boundary: Regional rolling aggregate, not inter-region power-flow optimization.
claims.statement: Summed over six regional rolling policies, the declared net operating-cost metric differs from the comparable no-storage baseline by the reported amount; negative costs denote net export revenue.

claims.review_boundary: Uses the declared grid-purchase carbon metric only.
claims.statement: For the same six regional rolling policies and no-storage baseline, the grid-purchase carbon metric differs by the reported amount.

claims.review_boundary: Deterministic 72-hour probes, not probabilistic or full-horizon guarantees.
claims.statement: All candidate and comparable-baseline audits for the four observed-data-derived 72-hour stress probes passed.

claims.review_boundary: The residual must be reported whenever reproduction is claimed.
claims.statement: Facility load is reproduced from the supplied load components and inferred regional PUE only within the reported maximum rounding-scale residual, not by exact equality.

claims.review_boundary: Exclusion evidence only; no LP metric or dispatch row is claim eligible.
claims.statement: The full-horizon relaxed LP probe is permanently excluded from claims because its RegionF audit records the reported simultaneous charge/discharge peak.
